purpose: Pre-registration of the round-2 student comparison, written before any of these runs had a validation or test result.
decoding_rationale: same as the frozen version-2 selection (data/scribe/v3/student/v2-selected/selection-frozen.json)

primary.change: training data only: Nemotron round 1 plus the round-2 notes accepted by the Jev gate; same configuration, seed and 324 optimisation steps; max_length guard raised from 1024 to 1536 because one long round-2 note has 1,050 tokens (a guard, not a truncation)
primary.endpoint: note-level exact match on test_nemotron and test_haiku pooled, paired exact McNemar against the reference

secondary.change: as primary plus the version-2 Haiku training notes (train_data nemotron+haiku)
version-2 data with the Haiku training notes (the Stage C data arm the ablation dropped for time)

multiplicity: Holm over the three comparisons with the reference
size_ladder: S-1b and S-4b (control LoRA r16) are scored on validation only; one is evaluated on test once only if it beats the reference on validation with exact McNemar p < 0.05
test_reads: each listed run is evaluated on the test splits exactly once
